pageText.lede: Each item lists the exact size, colour, and version I want, prices in CAD, plus a buy link. Tap any card to see more and edit it.

pageText.vibeText: Things I love the look of, even when I have no idea where they are from. Cute, a bit silly, dreamy or whimsical. Photos of that kind of thing now live on the Vibe board.
